question: Under what condition does devotion to the guru arise in the practitioner?
premises: Devotion to the guru is the outcome in question.
The arising of this devotion is conditional.
inference: Devotion to the guru arises if the requisite condition is fulfilled.
uncertainties: The protasis condition is not explicitly stated in this verse alone.
plain_english: O fortunate one, O mother, devotion to the guru arises, if it may be.
